assets.clearing: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: temporary illustrative hero photo for a professional land-clearing service website in northern Indiana. A wide landscape photograph showing a small residential acreage at the edge of deciduous woods in early autumn, a carefully opened grassy and earthy clearing in the foreground, patches of trimmed low brush, standing mature trees retained around the edges, a few neatly gathered cut branches well off to one side. No workers or equipment. Flat Midwestern terrain, realistic ordinary property, overcast warm morning light, subdued rich green and natural brown. The scene should show usable space after modest brush clearing, not pristine landscaping or an immense construction site. Eye-level editorial photography, detailed natural textures, 16:9 composition. No text, no logos, no watermark, no houses as focal point. This is an illustrative scene, not an actual company project.
assets.winter: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: temporary illustrative photo for a snow and ice management service page in northern Indiana. Wide editorial photograph of a modest Midwestern suburban property after a snowfall: a freshly plowed asphalt driveway curves toward a distant simple home, a shoveled concrete front walk connects to it, soft snowbanks and snow-covered dormant lawn either side, bare deciduous trees and a few evergreens. Clean cleared walking and driving surfaces are main focus, with realistic residual snow around edges; no promise of perfectly ice-free surfaces. No vehicles, workers, logos, text, watermark. Calm pale winter daylight, deep muted evergreen accents, natural realistic photography, 16:9 landscape composition. Not a luxury mansion, no mountains. This is an illustrative scene, not an actual company project.
